description: List ERCOT generation interconnection queue projects (solar, wind, battery storage, gas) near a Texas address or coordinate, in a county, or at a named point of interconnection (POI) substation, with fuel, MW, study status, POI substation and distance. Use when someone asks what generation or storage is planned nearby, how congested an area is, about the ERCOT queue in a county, or what is queued at a substation. Free accounts get every location and type; names, sizes, owners and dates are Pro.

address.description: Texas street address, e.g. '1201 Main St, Houston, TX'. Use this or lat/lng.

county.description: Texas county name. Use this or a location or poi.

fuel.description: Filter by fuel: SOL, WIN, GAS, OTH, NUC.

lat.description: Latitude (WGS84). Use with lng instead of address.

lng.description: Longitude (WGS84). Use with lat instead of address.

poi.description: Point of interconnection substation name to match, e.g. 'Paint Creek' or 'Bearkat'.

name: ercot_queue
title: ERCOT interconnection queue near a site
